# telnyx_fqdns (Data Source)

Lists fqdns, with optional filters. Each item has the attributes of `telnyx_fqdn`.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `filter_connection_id` (String) ID of the FQDN connection to which the FQDN belongs.
- `filter_dns_record_type` (String) DNS record type used by the FQDN.
- `filter_fqdn` (String) FQDN represented by the resource.
- `filter_port` (Number) Port to use when connecting to the FQDN.
- `max_items` (Number) Stop reading after this many items. By default every page is read.

### Read-Only

- `fqdns` (Attributes List) The objects, in the order the API returns them. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--fqdns))

<a id="nestedatt--fqdns"></a>
### Nested Schema for `fqdns`

Read-Only:

- `connection_id` (String) ID of the FQDN connection to which this FQDN is attached.
- `created_at` (String) ISO 8601 formatted date indicating when the resource was created.
- `dns_record_type` (String) The DNS record type for the FQDN. For cases where a port is not set, the DNS record type must be 'srv'. For cases where a port is set, the DNS record type must be 'a'. If the DNS record type is 'a' and a port is not specified, 5060 will be used.
- `fqdn` (String) FQDN represented by this resource.
- `id` (String) Identifies the resource.
- `port` (Number) Port to use when connecting to this FQDN.
- `record_type` (String) Identifies the type of the resource.
- `updated_at` (String) ISO 8601 formatted date indicating when the resource was updated.
